title: MED+250 production security and catalogue contract deployment
summary: The reviewed database migrations were applied to production, the migration ledger was reconciled, and unverified product imagery was removed from public catalogue and Storage exposure.

checks.name: Migration ledger alignment
checks.detail: All 57 production-authorised local MED+250 migrations are present in the production ledger with matching names; the separate pharmacy contact candidate import remains intentionally undeployed pending owner review.

checks.name: Publication audit enforcement
checks.detail: Production now rejects approved or rejected catalogue states that lack a matching immutable audit event for that row version.

checks.name: Verified product-image publication boundary
checks.detail: All 33 previously published rights-unverified rows were made non-public, catalogue image links were cleared, and 39 unverified or orphaned Storage objects were removed without emitting identifiers; the latest repair migration reasserted the boundary after a conflicting deployment.

checks.name: Deployment contract refresh
checks.detail: The production backend contract was refreshed to version 2026-07-16.8 and requires explicit reuse-rights verification in the schema constraint, publication RPC, and public RLS policy.
